# Town of Bennington municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 2; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Bennington charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 103 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 201(a) provides for seven Select Board members elected from the Town at large.

Town of Bennington official website, 'Elected Officials' page: lists the Select Board: Tom Haley (Chair), Jim Sullivan (Vice Chair), Clark Adams, Jackie Matts, Sarah Perrin, Nancy White, and Ed Woods. The Secretary of State's Selectboard Members directory publishes no Bennington roster.
Town of Bennington charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 103 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 201(a) makes the Town Clerk an elective officer.

Town of Bennington official website, 'Elected Officials' page: lists 'Town of Bennington: Cassandra Barbeau' as Town Clerk. The Secretary of State's Guide (January 2026) and clerk contact spreadsheet (June 12, 2026) list Kayla Thompson, whom the town's current page supersedes; Thompson is not recorded.
Town of Bennington charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 103 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 201(a) makes the Treasurer an elective officer.
Town of Bennington official website, 'Elected Officials' page: lists 'Town of Bennington: Joan Pinsonneault' as Town Treasurer.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Joan Pinsonneault as Town Treasurer of Bennington. The Secretary of State's treasurer contact spreadsheet prints no Bennington treasurer ('Contact Town Clerk for more information').

Town of Bennington charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 103 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 201(a) makes the Moderator an elective officer. No town page names the current Moderator (the town's Government, Town Meetings, Elections, and Election Results pages were all checked), so no holder is recorded.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Bennington justices of the peace.

jp_election.name: Town of Bennington Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Bennington justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
